Single trade-press source; no second corroborating report was found. The report describes Artesian as the backer without stating a lead/participant split, so Artesian is recorded as a participant, not a lead.

blurb.text: Co-founder and chief executive of Andromeda Robotics, the company behind Abi, an empathetic companion robot designed to reduce loneliness, particularly in aged care. A mechatronics engineer who began building robots in her teens, Brown developed Abi from its earliest stages through the Startmate accelerator. Her recognition includes Forbes 30 Under 30 and the Top 50 Women in Robotics.

startups.name: FloodMapp
startups.description: Flood forecasting and inundation mapping software for emergency managers and infrastructure operators.

blurb.text: Co-founder and chief executive of FloodMapp, which provides predictive flood modelling and real-time hazard mapping. A chartered professional water resources engineer (CPEng, RPEQ), Murphy spent more than a decade specialising in surface water management, flood modelling, mine water management and water supply planning across Australia, Indonesia and Canada before founding FloodMapp. Her decision to start the company was motivated by experiencing the 2011 Queensland floods and the 2013 Calgary flood firsthand. She was named Founder of the Year at the Women in Digital National Awards.
